notes: Job-log snippets for the root-cause tests (docs/overhaul/02-models.md §14, §21.2), written in the shape of the managers' jobs ledger: the redacted docker run line, then container output.

Host paths appear only as <AI_ROOT>; container paths are kept. vllm-port-in-use-with-secrets carries obviously fake secrets and ANSI colour codes on purpose, so the redaction and normalisation steps have something to remove.

expected.code and expected.signatureId follow the error-signature ids of 02 §8.4; a null signatureId means the traceback fallback (engine_start_failed). llama-mmproj-missing names the id the root-cause test gives its stubbed llama.cpp descriptor addition (01 §16.3).

Model facts in samples with a modelFixture (file name, KV and tensor counts, tensor type counts, n_embd, n_layer, experts, file size and BPW) match that fixture; the trigger strings are the ones 02 §21.2 names. Device names, free memory, buffer sizes, timings and build ids are illustrative.

expected.redactedWithSecrets: gone after redactSecrets(text, {secrets: that list}). expected.redactedByPatterns: gone after redactSecrets(text) with the default patterns only, as the job-log path (job-utils sanitizeJobLogText) calls it. The API key in vLLM's 'non-default args' list literal is redacted only as a known secret: the key-value pattern stops at '['.
